---
kind: pipeline
name: baseimage

platform:
  os: linux
  arch: amd64

trigger:
  branch:
    - master
    - develop
  event:
    exclude:
      - pull_request

steps:
  - name: Docker tag
    image: busybox
    commands:
      - sh docker/tags.sh
    when:
      event:
        exclude:
          - pull_request

  - name: Build Docker baseimage
    image: plugins/docker
    settings:
      repo: axarev/parsr-base
      context: docker/parsr-base
      dockerfile: docker/parsr-base/Dockerfile
      username:
        from_secret: registry_user
      password:
        from_secret: registry_password

---
kind: pipeline
name: API

platform:
  os: linux
  arch: amd64

trigger:
  branch:
    - master
    - develop

steps:
  - name: Change file ownership
    image: alpine:latest
    commands:
      - chown -R 1001:0 /drone/src

  - name: Build API
    image: axarev/parsr-base:${DRONE_BRANCH}
    pull: always
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: development
    commands:
      - docker/parsr/build.sh

  - name: Tests
    image: axarev/parsr-base:${DRONE_BRANCH}
    commands:
      - npm run test

  - name: Docker tag
    image: busybox
    commands:
      - sh docker/tags.sh
    when:
      event:
        exclude:
          - pull_request

  - name: Build Docker API image
    image: plugins/docker
    settings:
      repo: axarev/parsr
      context: .
      dockerfile: docker/parsr/Dockerfile
      username:
        from_secret: registry_user
      password:
        from_secret: registry_password
      build_args:
        DEV_MODE: 'true'
        BASEIMAGE_VERSION: ${DRONE_BRANCH}
    when:
      event:
        exclude:
          - pull_request

depends_on:
  - baseimage

---
kind: pipeline
name: UI

platform:
  os: linux
  arch: amd64

trigger:
  branch:
    - master
    - develop

steps:
  - name: Change file ownership
    image: alpine:latest
    commands:
      - chown -R 1001:0 /drone/src

  - name: Build UI
    image: registry.access.redhat.com/ubi8/nodejs-10
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: development
    commands:
      - docker/parsr-ui/build.sh

  - name: Docker tag
    image: busybox
    commands:
      - sh docker/tags.sh
    when:
      event:
        exclude:
          - pull_request

  - name: Build UI Docker image
    image: plugins/docker
    settings:
      repo: axarev/parsr-ui-localhost
      context: .
      dockerfile: docker/parsr-ui/Dockerfile
      username:
        from_secret: registry_user
      password:
        from_secret: registry_password
      build_args:
        VUE_APP_API: http://localhost:3001
    when:
      event:
        exclude:
          - pull_request

---
kind: pipeline
name: Sonarqube

platform:
  os: linux
  arch: amd64

trigger:
  branch:
    - master
  event:
    exclude:
      - pull_request

steps:
  - name: Code analysis
    image: aosapps/drone-sonar-plugin
    detach: false
    failure: ignore
    settings:
      sonar_host:
        from_secret: sonar_host
      sonar_token:
        from_secret: sonar_token
      level: INFO
      sources: .
      exclusions: dist
      usingProperties: true

  - name: Slack
    image: slallemand/slack-webhook:latest
    environment:
      SLACK_WEBHOOK:
        from_secret: slack_webhook
      SONAR_HOST:
        from_secret: sonar_host
    commands:
      - SLACK_TEXT="New sonarqube report available on $SONAR_HOST/dashboard?id=parsr" /src/slack.py

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  API:
    needs:
      - baseimage
    if: (github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.ref_name == 'master' || github.base_ref == 'master' || (github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.ref_name == 'develop' || github.base_ref == 'develop')) && !github.event.deleted
    runs-on: linux/amd64
    steps:
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/API/step/Change file ownership
      - id: Change-file-ownership
        uses: docker://alpine:latest
        with:
          entrypoint: /bin/sh
          args: -ec 'chown -R 1001:0 /drone/src'
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/API/step/Build API
      - id: Build-API
        run: docker run --rm -v "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE:$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" -w "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" -e NODE_ENV --entrypoint /bin/sh -- "$PIPEMASTER_IMAGE" -ec "$PIPEMASTER_SCRIPT"
        env:
          NODE_ENV: development
          PIPEMASTER_IMAGE: axarev/parsr-base:${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          PIPEMASTER_SCRIPT: docker/parsr/build.sh
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/API/step/Tests
      - id: Tests
        run: docker run --rm -v "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE:$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" -w "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --entrypoint /bin/sh -- "$PIPEMASTER_IMAGE" -ec "$PIPEMASTER_SCRIPT"
        env:
          PIPEMASTER_IMAGE: axarev/parsr-base:${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          PIPEMASTER_SCRIPT: npm run test
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/API/step/Docker tag
      - id: Docker-tag
        if: '!(github.event_name == ''pull_request'')'
        uses: docker://busybox
        with:
          entrypoint: /bin/sh
          args: -ec 'sh docker/tags.sh'
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/API/step/Build Docker API image
      - id: Build-Docker-API-image
        if: '!(github.event_name == ''pull_request'')'
        uses: docker://plugins/docker
        env:
          PLUGIN_CONTEXT: .
          PLUGIN_DOCKERFILE: docker/parsr/Dockerfile
          PLUGIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.registry_password }}
          PLUGIN_REPO: axarev/parsr
          PLUGIN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.registry_user }}
  Sonarqube:
    if: '!(github.event_name == ''pull_request'') && (github.ref_type == ''branch'' && github.ref_name == ''master'' || github.base_ref == ''master'') && !github.event.deleted'
    runs-on: linux/amd64
    steps:
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/Sonarqube/step/Code analysis
      - id: Code-analysis
        uses: docker://aosapps/drone-sonar-plugin
        env:
          PLUGIN_EXCLUSIONS: dist
          PLUGIN_LEVEL: INFO
          PLUGIN_SONAR_HOST: ${{ secrets.sonar_host }}
          PLUGIN_SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.sonar_token }}
          PLUGIN_SOURCES: .
          PLUGIN_USINGPROPERTIES: "true"
        continue-on-error: true
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/Sonarqube/step/Slack
      - id: Slack
        uses: docker://slallemand/slack-webhook:latest
        with:
          entrypoint: /bin/sh
          args: -ec 'SLACK_TEXT="New sonarqube report available on $SONAR_HOST/dashboard?id=parsr" /src/slack.py'
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.slack_webhook }}
          SONAR_HOST: ${{ secrets.sonar_host }}
  UI:
    if: (github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.ref_name == 'master' || github.base_ref == 'master' || (github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.ref_name == 'develop' || github.base_ref == 'develop')) && !github.event.deleted
    runs-on: linux/amd64
    steps:
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/UI/step/Change file ownership
      - id: Change-file-ownership
        uses: docker://alpine:latest
        with:
          entrypoint: /bin/sh
          args: -ec 'chown -R 1001:0 /drone/src'
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/UI/step/Build UI
      - id: Build-UI
        uses: docker://registry.access.redhat.com/ubi8/nodejs-10
        with:
          entrypoint: /bin/sh
          args: -ec docker/parsr-ui/build.sh
        env:
          NODE_ENV: development
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/UI/step/Docker tag
      - id: Docker-tag
        if: '!(github.event_name == ''pull_request'')'
        uses: docker://busybox
        with:
          entrypoint: /bin/sh
          args: -ec 'sh docker/tags.sh'
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/UI/step/Build UI Docker image
      - id: Build-UI-Docker-image
        if: '!(github.event_name == ''pull_request'')'
        uses: docker://plugins/docker
        env:
          PLUGIN_CONTEXT: .
          PLUGIN_DOCKERFILE: docker/parsr-ui/Dockerfile
          PLUGIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.registry_password }}
          PLUGIN_REPO: axarev/parsr-ui-localhost
          PLUGIN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.registry_user }}
  baseimage:
    if: '!(github.event_name == ''pull_request'') && (github.ref_type == ''branch'' && github.ref_name == ''master'' || github.base_ref == ''master'' || (github.ref_type == ''branch'' && github.ref_name == ''develop'' || github.base_ref == ''develop'')) && !github.event.deleted'
    runs-on: linux/amd64
    steps:
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/baseimage/step/Docker tag
      - id: Docker-tag
        if: '!(github.event_name == ''pull_request'')'
        uses: docker://busybox
        with:
          entrypoint: /bin/sh
          args: -ec 'sh docker/tags.sh'
      # pipemaster:emulated step.image pipeline/drone/job/baseimage/step/Build Docker baseimage
      - id: Build-Docker-baseimage
        uses: docker://plugins/docker
        env:
          PLUGIN_CONTEXT: docker/parsr-base
          PLUGIN_DOCKERFILE: docker/parsr-base/Dockerfile
          PLUGIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.registry_password }}
          PLUGIN_REPO: axarev/parsr-base
          PLUGIN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.registry_user }}

    - linux/amd64

  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "master" || $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME == "master" || ($CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop" || $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME == "develop")

    # pipemaster:step Change file ownership

    exclude:
      - .git/**/*
    expire_in: 1 day

      - .

  script:

    # pipemaster:step Tests

    exclude:
      - .git/**/*
    expire_in: 1 day
    paths:
      - .

    - linux/amd64
  needs:
    - API-2
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "master" || $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME == "master" || ($CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop" || $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME == "develop")

    # pipemaster:step Docker tag

      sh docker/tags.sh
      fi

    # pipemaster:emulated step.if pipeline/drone/job/API/step/Build Docker API image
    # pipemaster:arg "!(event == 'merge_request_event')"
    # pipemaster:arg {"src":"!(event == 'pull_request')"}
    - |
      if ! [ "$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE" = "merge_request_event" ]; then
      printf '%s\n' 'pipemaster: lost: step.action pipeline/drone/job/API/step/Build Docker API image: the step kind has no GitLab form' >&2; exit 1

  tags:
    - linux/amd64

  rules:
    - if: '!($CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event") && ($CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "master" || $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME == "master")'
  script:
    # pipemaster:step Code analysis

    - 'printf ''%s\n'' ''pipemaster: lost: step.action pipeline/drone/job/Sonarqube/step/Code analysis: the step kind has no GitLab form'' >&2; exit 1 || true'

    - |
      (
      export SLACK_WEBHOOK="$slack_webhook"
      export SONAR_HOST="$sonar_host"
      SLACK_TEXT="New sonarqube report available on $SONAR_HOST/dashboard?id=parsr" /src/slack.py
      )
